learning_signal: On persuasion-typed text audits the style's edge over a raw audit is not more flaw-finding (both found all 8) but flaw prioritization and incentive weighting: identify the load-bearing assumption whose failure flips the recommendation, verify it by the cheapest decisive check (the docs' arithmetic), rank rhetoric as corroboration, and treat deadlines/incentives as weighted decision inputs; graded evidence quality and a who-benefits scan make this a completion contract rather than a REVIEW afterthought.

human_model: Critical Reading / Socratic Questioning of Texts
key_gap: the v5 human baseline failed its own style's registered weakness ('can miss the forest'): it applied a science-publication evidence bar to a time-sensitive operations decision — discounted the records-corroborated n=1 anecdote and the Bridge-M fingerprint as 'analogy and anecdote', treated the $300K-vs-$60M asymmetry as rhetorical 'catastrophic framing', and demanded the 4-week FE analysis as a precondition, keeping the bridge open. The routed v6 run (unconfident → dual-route m018 steel-man + m019 adversary, with m003 inversion and m007 ruin gates) classified the decision class first, verified the anecdote against the maintenance records, priced the negative branches (break-even p = 0.5%; delay cost $0.6–12M for p ∈ 1–20%), closed for 72h with FE parallelized, and downgraded 'will collapse' to a non-dismissive calibration note.
learning_signal: Critical-reading passes under decision pressure must be gated by decision-class fit: the evidence bar belongs to the decision (time-sensitivity, reversibility, downside asymmetry), not the genre; a corroborated anecdote + analog fingerprint can be decision-grade when the action is cheap and reversible and the downside catastrophic; an unquantified probability is a reason to reason in provenance-backed bands, never a reason to refuse action; tone and overstatement are calibration findings about the messenger, not grounds to invert a cheap-to-verify, catastrophic-to-ignore claim.
suggested_improvement: When routing is unconfident on high_stakes signatures, dual-route away from pure text-critique styles toward steel-man + adversary with mandatory m007 ruin screen and m003 inversion (R4 guarantee prepend); install the forest-vs-trees guard (m094 contract) as a STANDING gate on all text-analysis passes — classify close-or-wait/act-or-study before any evidence critique, ask 'is this critique decision-relevant?' and 'what does waiting cost in expected value?' per critique, and require an expected-value line in the packet whenever NEEDS_EVIDENCE/APPROXIMATED is considered.
